# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 24 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 24 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_024_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 24

**24:1** I am James — the one who wrote down this history. When the chaos broke out in Jerusalem after Herod's death, I pulled back into the desert and waited there until things had quieted down. I praise the Lord God, who gave me the wisdom to set all this down.

**24:2** May grace rest on all who fear the Lord. Amen.
